next.reason: 1985 'must not duplicate any condition specified for the I-O status values 00 through 49' and §2023:9.1.13.11 GR1 'This condition shall not duplicate any other condition specified by another I-O status value' bar the same set for every status a 1985 program can receive (00-49 were all the non-9x values in 1985); x stays implementor-defined. The wider reach (5x, 6x, 7x) arises only from features 1985 lacks.
